GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-05-04T13:10:20Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Is it OK to connect with Gmail using SMTP to send email while already connected using IMAP?
Description: This is more of a general question, but I am parsing emails using IMAP for a C# program. I also want to send out some notification emails using SMTP while I am connected to Gmail using IMAP.
I read that IMAP is not useful for sending emails.

I was wondering if this is OK. I did try it, and it works fine, just something lingering. 

    `  using (var imapClient = new ImapClient())
       {
	      //connect with IMAP and do stuff..

	       using (SmtpClient smtpClient = new SmtpClient())
	      {
		  //while already connected with IMAP, connect again to send emails
		  smtpClient.Disconnect(true);
	      }
	         imapClient.Disconnect(true);
        }`
